## Context (measured at groom against the pinned base)

**Why this card exists.** tests[133] (issue_id `t26`) greps
`.github/workflows/deploy.yml` and asserts that `RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK` is the
**only** secret the workflow may reference. The operator's approved method-2
edit adds a second secret, `RENDER_APP_URL`, so the premise the leg was written
against no longer exists and the stored gate is RED on exactly that one leg. The
tree is therefore dishonest in two places at once: the workflow edit is
uncommitted, and the gate that governs the workflow asserts a world that has
passed. Neither is reviewable alone - committing the edit without re-premising
the gate leaves a RED gate with no route to green, and re-premising the gate
without committing the edit changes a stored gate to bless bytes nobody
committed. One card, two deliverables.

**The measured amendment target** (read from the live index at groom, not
restated from prose):

|---|---|
| stored tests[133].command | 3106 bytes, sha256 `748f28c0...` (full value in the handoff) |
| amended tests[133].command | 3547 bytes, sha256 `b2a662b9...` (full value in the handoff) |
| replacement offset | 2248 - ONE contiguous swap, prefix and suffix byte-identical |
| BASE deploy.yml blob | `8c1e3ab14e74869bbcf958f8d373b942704f1269` (1481 bytes, 1 secret) |
| operator-edit blob | `17c11618859e68230ebc74a6a748f519bc1fe184` (1507 bytes LF, 2 secrets) |
| the operator diff | exactly 2 lines added (`env:` + `APP_HEALTH_URL: ${{ secrets.RENDER_APP_URL }}`) and the curl line rewritten from the literal URL to `"$APP_HEALTH_URL"` - `git diff --stat` measured 3 insertions / 1 deletion |

**The re-premise, not the relaxation.** The single-secret equality is replaced
by (i) a CLOSED two-secret allowlist - every `secrets.*` name in the workflow
must be inside `{RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK, RENDER_APP_URL}` and `RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK`
must still be present - and (ii) a placement control - `RENDER_APP_URL` may
appear exactly once and only after the `Verify the deployed health endpoint`
step marker. A third distinct secret REDS the gate; the allow-listed second
secret REDS it if it migrates into the hook step or is referenced twice. Every
other leg of the command is byte-identical, including the legs that keep the
plaintext hook URL forbidden (`api.render.com/deploy/`), require `-X POST`, the
bounded retry (`seq 1`, `sleep`), the failure exit (`exit 1`), the health path
`/api/v1/health`, the >=2-step deploy job, and all e2e.yml legs.

so each fence materialises its probe from a base64 payload instead of typing
python into the shell.

## Goal

Make the tree honest about what the deploy workflow now is - a two-secret
workflow (hook + health-verify) whose stored gate still protects a real rule -
by committing the operator's edit byte-identical and by recording a re-premise of
tests[133] that a third secret still gets caught by.

## Acceptance criteria

Five fenced ACs (`limits.issue_granularity.max_acs` = 6). Each fence is
self-contained: it materialises a pinned python probe from a base64 payload in
its own text, runs it against the working tree, and fails loudly if python3 is
missing rather than skipping. Every value a leg needs is re-extracted from the
artifact that owns it - the live index, the record's own texts, or git objects -
so no digest, count or message is restated in prose and then trusted. Each fence
was measured at groom: ac1 GREEN on the record as it stands, ac2 RED until the
builder commits the edit (the RED names the leg), ac3 GREEN on the working-tree
edit with all five control cases firing, ac4 GREEN, ac5 GREEN. **re_groom
disclosure (operator ruling OPTION A):** the ac2 fence below is the RE-PREMISED
probe - the groom-time probe's moved-leg compared pre/post lines by POSITIONAL
zip, which structurally cannot pass the mandated MID-FILE insertion (every line
after the hunk shifts, so unchanged lines paired against shifted lines and the
leg REDd even on a byte-perfect commit - reproduced on the builder's commit
`8122b56c` at rc=1). The moved-leg now decomposes the committed diff with
difflib opcodes and pins the SAME intent, not a weaker one: exactly 2 non-equal
opcodes (the 2-line env insert, position-pinned directly after the health-verify
step name, and the curl-constant replace), 3 lines added, 1 removed, 0 deletes,
0 non-equal opcodes anywhere else. The mutation battery (9 cases, in the re_groom
handoff) shows the fixed probe GREEN on the real commit and RED on every mutant
that moves, adds, reorders, or deletes anything outside the mandated hunk. The
other four fences are byte-unchanged from groom; the PRODUCT BYTES are frozen -
the builder re-runs the fixed fences on the existing commit `8122b56c` and writes
no new product bytes.

## Constraints (hard)

- **Authored-file scope is 4** (`limits.issue_granularity.max_files` = 4): the
  two PRODUCT paths `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` (the operator's edit,
  committed byte-identical - nothing else may move in it) and
  `docs/state/outputs/t90_definer_gate_amendment.json` (the record: definer
  authors it at groom, the builder carries it forward UNCHANGED), plus the
  card's own room `docs/issues/t90.md` / `docs/issues/groom/t90.md` and the
  card-scoped output prefix `docs/state/outputs/t90_*` (groom handoff, builder
  implement, verifier verify). Numeric diff budget: `max_diff_lines` = 300 over
  the product pair (measured 3 insertions / 1 deletion for `deploy.yml` alone);
  `warn_only` is true in config, so the number is a review signal, and ac4's
  allow-list is the hard fence.
- The definer and the builder NEVER edit `docs/state/merge_test_index.json`. The
  amendment is a RECORD; the orchestrator applies it in the strict merge window
  and re-hashes. If the applied command does not hash to the record's
  `new_command_sha256`, the application is wrong and must stop.
- RE-PREMISE, never relax: the amended leg must bite on a third distinct secret,
  on a misplaced `RENDER_APP_URL`, and on a second reference. If any of the three
  controls goes GREEN, this card FAILS. No leg of tests[133] is deleted.
- Do not touch any other leg of tests[133], any other index entry, anything
  under `.github/**` beyond committing the recorded operator edit, `render.yaml`
  (t91), `README.md`, `docs/criteria/**`, `ops/**`, `security/**`, `tests/**`,
  `scripts/**`, `backend/**`, `frontend/**`, `docs/requirements.md`,
  `docs/plan.md`, `docs/backlog.md`.
- Do not close, comment on, or relabel any platform issue beyond this card's own
  groom sync; #61 stays untouched (t95 owns the only sanctioned close).
- The survey ASSUMPTION is now MEASURED, not assumed: the 318-entry static scan
  and the nine-gate execution matrix above are the evidence that no other stored
  gate greps `deploy.yml` for a single secret or for the curl-line shape the
